**I solved the issue**
The problem was the LSFG-VK driver being installed for Lossless Scaling Frame Generation.

https://github.com/PancakeTAS/lsfg-vk

FYI I also had this happen in a project, only in `v4.8.dev.custom_build [e7cfa294a]` when I attempted to load a project I am working on.

So it may be more common once 4.8 releases or maybe just random idk. I removed LSFG-VK and it fixed it.
